donate.note: One Stripe payment link per amount. Paste each link between the quotes. The amounts shown on the site are the numbers in this list, so to change an amount, change its number and its link. 'other' is the link where the donor chooses what to pay (one-off only). A gift whose link is empty shows a 'not switched on yet' message.

applications.note: Adoption and foster applications use the forms in the charity's Pawlytics account (Pawlytics, Forms). embed is the address inside the page; page is the same form on its own page, used for the link under it. If Pawlytics ever changes a form, copy the new addresses from Pawlytics, Forms.

forms.note: Where the contact and newsletter forms send their answers. Leave empty while testing: forms then go straight to the thank-you page and send nothing. On Netlify, set this to / to use Netlify Forms. Adoption and foster applications do not use this: they go through the Pawlytics forms (see applications).

notes.social: Paste each social page address between the quotes. Until one is filled in, its link in the footer shows [add link].
notes.wishlist: Paste the Amazon wish list address here. Until then the Open the wish list buttons do nothing.
